posts.title: October 22: Film screening of Msit No’kmaq (All My Relations) documentary
posts.description: The documentary I've been working on for the last few months about the fight to end the second-generation cut-off impacting First Nations families in Canada is screening at Amnesty International in Ottawa next week.

posts.title: Self-Publishing and Things to Consider (with filmmakers)
posts.description: A round-table discussion sharing practical insights, tools, and experiences on self-publishing versus traditional publishing with two self-published filmmakers Christine Chen and Noelle Cope chat with myself, a traditionally published children's book author/illustrator and filmmaker.

posts.title: Intro to Script Breakdown and Film Budgeting
posts.description: Intro to Script Breakdown with 1st AD, DGA/Writer/Director, Christine Chen. This is best for first time filmmakers, producers, 1st ADs and/or new and emerging writer/directors.
